response.sql: WITH patient_ratios AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB * 1.0 / HCT) AS ratio FROM Laboratory WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL AND HCT <> 0 GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS overall_avg FROM patient_ratios), above_overall AS (SELECT p.ID, p.ratio, p.ratio - o.overall_avg AS above_overall FROM patient_ratios p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.ratio > o.overall_avg), group_average AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS group_avg FROM above_overall) SELECT AVG(a.ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(a.above_overall) AS avg_above_overall, AVG(a.ratio - g.group_avg) AS avg_above_group FROM above_overall a CROSS JOIN group_average g WHERE a.ratio > g.group_avg;
